kjv.1CH 9:17: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

disputed_verses.BHSA 1CH 9:17: וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים֙ שַׁלּ֣וּם וְעַקּ֔וּב וְטַלְמֹ֖ן וַאֲחִימָ֑ן וַאֲחִיהֶ֥ם שַׁלּ֖וּם הָרֹֽאשׁ׃
disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 9:17: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

first_reader_said: 1CH 9:17: Both records are the gatekeeper Akkub listed with Shallum, Talmon and Ahiman.

why: Both records identify the same Akkub in the same gatekeeper list with Shallum, Talmon, and Ahiman (1CH 9:17); B supplies no independent lineage or occurrence distinguishing another person. A preserves that occurrence and the additional gatekeeper references, including the children of Akkub in EZR 2:42 and NEH 7:45, so B is a thinner duplicate of A.
